decisions.reason: Height-adjustable desks remain in demand for flexible offices and it builds on existing expertise.
Chair families are core seating products with steady commercial and residential demand.
Floor cushions from carpets leverage existing materials but occupy a niche, giving a slightly higher drop risk.
The upholstered sofa fits the premium living portfolio and design collaboration supports continuity.
High standing tables align with workplace trends and complement the desk system.
Rug collection is farther from core furniture, so it has a higher probability of being pruned, but still fits interior solutions.
